chapters.title: Ask Sig
chapters.description: Find a follow-up and open the seller behind it.

chapters.title: Analyze a deal
chapters.description: Compare two methods and save a sample offer.

chapters.title: Review a call
chapters.description: Turn a seller conversation into appointment fields.

scenes.title: Start with your priorities
scenes.hint: Select My follow-ups to ask Sig what needs attention.
scenes.alt: Avery’s Today workspace shows the Ask Sig box, suggested questions and a summary of open work.

scenes.title: Ask about follow-ups
scenes.hint: Send the suggested question with the arrow in Ask Sig.
scenes.alt: The Today composer contains the suggested question about follow-ups and its send arrow is ready.

scenes.title: Check the follow-up queue
scenes.hint: Send the prepared question to find Taylor Green’s next step.
scenes.alt: Sig lists open follow-ups including Taylor Green. A second question about Taylor is ready to send.

scenes.title: Trace the answer to its source
scenes.hint: Select Taylor Green underneath Sig’s answer to open the seller record.
scenes.alt: Sig answers the question about Taylor Green and includes a Taylor Green source button below the response.

scenes.title: Open the seller record
scenes.hint: Review Taylor’s property and next step. Return to Sig using the assistant in the top bar.
scenes.alt: Taylor Green’s seller record shows the property, assigned representative and directory next step.

scenes.title: Estimate a resale offer
scenes.hint: Calculate with the example figures, or tap Method to try the other scenario.
scenes.alt: Single-family wholesale inputs show a $270,000 resale price, $25,000 in repairs, $15,000 in selling costs, $6,000 in holding costs and a $30,000 profit target.

scenes.title: Review the maximum offer
scenes.hint: Open Save deal scenario to keep the estimate with its assumptions.
scenes.alt: The analyzer shows $270,000 in resale proceeds, $76,000 in costs and target profit, and a $194,000 maximum offer.

scenes.title: Save the reviewed scenario
scenes.hint: Tap Save record to add the example to the deal register.
scenes.alt: The save form contains Maple Lane · resale scenario, Reviewed status, the selected method, estimated offer and original inputs.

scenes.title: Find the saved scenario
scenes.hint: The register keeps the method, estimated offer and assumptions together.
scenes.alt: The saved register row for Maple Lane · resale scenario is expanded. Its reviewed scenario records an offer of $194,000.

scenes.title: Estimate an income property
scenes.hint: Calculate with the example figures, or tap Method to try the other scenario.
scenes.alt: Multifamily inputs show $8,400 monthly rent, 5% vacancy, $35,760 annual expenses, an 8% cap rate and $60,000 of capital work.

scenes.title: Review the income valuation
scenes.hint: Open Save deal scenario to keep the estimate with its assumptions.
scenes.alt: The analyzer shows $95,760 of effective annual rent, $60,000 net operating income, a $750,000 valuation and a $690,000 estimated offer after capital work.

scenes.title: Save the reviewed scenario
scenes.hint: Tap Save record to add the example to the deal register.
scenes.alt: The save form contains Cedar Court · income scenario, Reviewed status, the selected method, estimated offer and original inputs.

scenes.title: Find the saved scenario
scenes.hint: The register keeps the method, estimated offer and assumptions together.
scenes.alt: The saved register row for Cedar Court · income scenario is expanded. Its reviewed scenario records an offer of $690,000.

scenes.title: Find a seller call
scenes.hint: Select the Harbor Example Lane recording in the search results.
scenes.alt: Workspace search shows a call for 14 Harbor Example Lane under the Calls filter.

scenes.title: Review the call
scenes.hint: Read the original conversation or use it to prepare the visit.
scenes.alt: The call summary shows the seller’s concern about timing, the next step and the property details.

scenes.title: Read the transcript
scenes.hint: Take the details from this conversation into the appointment form.
scenes.alt: The transcript for 14 Harbor Example Lane describes three beds, two baths and a Friday visit.

scenes.title: Prepare the visit
scenes.hint: Use the sample transcript to fill out a draft property record.
scenes.alt: The appointment form contains the original transcript, ready to prepare fields.

scenes.title: Review the prepared fields
scenes.hint: The address and property details are ready for review.
scenes.alt: The prepared draft includes the address and property type from the sample conversation.
